extractor.formatObservedLocally: byte varint-style values using low 7 bits per byte and high-bit continuation
extractor.yieldedUnit: number values documented locally as per-entity payload sizes in bits

handlerUse.createPayloadIterator: builds EntityPayloadSizeExtractor(message.serializedEntities).retrieve() and advances it by startLoop
handlerUse.listPayloadSizes: materializes all payload sizes for compact diagnostics and packet metrics
handlerUse.availability: payloadSizes iterator is created when entity class filtering or recovery/diagnostics are active
handlerUse.updateUse: UPDATE consumes one payloadBits item before entity extraction or missing-entity fail-closed handling
handlerUse.createUse: CREATE consumes one payloadBits item before class/serial/baseline/extraction handling
handlerUse.leaveDeleteUse: LEAVE and DELETE are recorded with payloadBits 0 by local handler logic
handlerUse.normalCursorAdvance: normal parsing advances through EntityMutationExtractor or command-specific reads, not by universally moving payloadBits

contractLimitations: serializedEntities and entityData are distinct message fields.
The extractor does not validate entry alignment against updatedEntries by itself.
The extractor does not prove payloadBits is equal to afterAction - afterCommand for every command/action path.
The extractor does not authorize using payloadBits as a recovery skip length.
